concept: llama.cpp normalisation of Claude Code billing header cch
summary: The converter's code comment calls the cch stamp "a whitebox end-to-end integrity hint" that is not meaningful as system-prompt data to llama.cpp, and notes it changes on each request so the prefix cache "will not get past it".

facts.text: The converter's code comment calls the cch stamp "a whitebox end-to-end integrity hint" that is not meaningful as system-prompt data to llama.cpp, and notes it changes on each request so the prefix cache "will not get past it".
The function does nothing unless the system text starts with the exact prefix `x-anthropic-billing-header:`.

The function replaces exactly five characters after `cch=` with `f` only when the character after them is `;`; otherwise it logs `anthropic string not as expected: <text>` at error level and leaves the text unchanged.
The normaliser is called both for a string-typed `system` field and for each `text` block in an array-typed `system` field, before the blocks are concatenated into one system message.

The code comment's example header is `x-anthropic-billing-header: cc_version=2.1.101.e51; cc_entrypoint=cli; cch=a5145;You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.`, so the checksum and the identity sentence can share one system text.

Before the change, the PR author saw prefix reuse stop at `n_past` about 18,577 even with a 60k context, and the `/slots` prompt diff showed line 62 (the billing header) differing while over 5,000 following lines matched.
On the second request after the change, slot selection moved from `sim_best = 0.566, f_keep = 0.704` to `sim_best = 0.805, f_keep = 1.000`, and later requests showed `sim_best = 0.994`.

The PR author reasoned the cost for non-Claude traffic is a single-position prefix check per system message, and chose to replace the value instead of deleting the header because a meaningful string sometimes follows it.
The author wrote the replacement defensively because the checksum is always five hexadecimal characters today but the protocol could change.

Reviewer ngxson approved PR 21793 on 2026-04-12 and the PR title was changed to `server: (anthropic API) fix prefix caching`; after the converter code moved, the author migrated the helper by hand, and ServeurpersoCom merged it on 2026-04-23 as commit c807c6e3b0c74b77ad4c7a8213a1d5690d34e462.
PR 21793 declares AI usage disclosure as "NO", with the code and PR text hand-written.

Inferred: a server that is not llama.cpp (oMLX, Rapid-MLX, LM Studio, Ollama) has no such normalisation in the sources read, so for them `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0` or Claude Code v2.1.181 or later remains the control.
Inferred: the `cc_version` hash suffix is a second possible cache-breaker on Claude Code builds older than v2.1.181 that this normaliser does not touch.
